activation: Active: root activated after Form A author quartet freeze on 2026-10-09.
canonical_requirement: Advanced replication-and-extension package with an identification memo, alternative specifications, inference diagnostics and referee report.
architecture: Create a coherent original synthetic research brief with supplied data and an explicit assignment/sampling law. Its baseline claims and tables form a genuine reproducible teaching replication; label it fictional throughout. Do not claim that reproducing synthetic results replicates an actual empirical paper.

Prefer a small randomized encouragement or longitudinal intervention design whose noncompliance, dependence and target parameters are explicit. Select the most pedagogically coherent design based on exact calculations; do not force every method from all twelve chapters into it.

Supply actual analysis-ready inputs, data dictionary, provenance and transformations; specify a standard-library Python benchmark implementation, deterministic output, manifest and README. Final package will own nine paths corresponding to the prior V11 project pattern, but only design file is authorized now.

Distinguish intention-to-treat, treatment-receipt effects and descriptive regression targets. A cross-fitted estimator for randomized encouragement estimates the assignment effect unless extra treatment identification assumptions hold. A ratio need not be finite or unbiased in small samples.

Use an exactly specified finite assignment law for exact tests and a separately stated repetition/superpopulation law if deriving asymptotic or simulation behavior. Any constant-effect randomization inversion must state its sharp invariance null and cannot be labeled a generic LATE confidence interval.

Build in at least two substantive extensions that change evidence or policy interpretation, such as dependence-appropriate inference, weak identification, missing outcomes, a declared direct-effect sensitivity class or support/transport. Give exact answers, bounds with attainability witnesses, or a complete evaluation rubric.

Include a short mandatory external-paper transfer dossier: selection criteria, access/provenance checks, identification/inference audit, reproduction log or honest access limitation, two feasible extensions and referee report. Provide an illustrative synthetic benchmark and grading criteria, but do not fabricate external replication results.

Specify a 100-point rubric with essential domain minima and critical identification/inference/integrity errors. Include complete instructor outputs/answers and counterfactual scope, not only deliverable names.

Reuse verified chapter sources with actual inspector attribution. No unnecessary retrieval or installations. No additional production reports duplicating the proposal: one compact evidence-bound design, exact original input law, anchors, proofs, promised files and unresolved issues.
required_design_gate: Independently calculate all numerical benchmark claims before freezing. Root will audit design and authorize final author files. No final manuscript/code, canonical/status/shared/hosting edits or child agents during design-only scope.
